capacity_sizing: Observed baseline (hosted POC): avg requests/sec 25, avg tokens/request 450, peak 1,800 reqs/sec (short bursts).
Traffic mix: reranking 60% of tokens (batch jobs), chat 30% (low latency), embeddings 10% (background).
Target SLOs: chat 99p latency <=150ms, p50 <40ms for short prompts, reranking throughput target: 6k qps aggregate during nightly window.
Recommended Dedicated pilot: 2 x A100-80GB (or 4 x A10G for cost-sensitive), model variants: quantized 8-bit for rerank, FP16 for chat low-latency; autoscale headroom for 3x observed baseline bursts.
Concurrency planning: average concurrency 75 sessions; steady-state concurrency for chat pegged to 25 qps; reserve 200 concurrent inference slots for burst headroom.
KV/prefix cache: expect 25% cache hit for chat (pinned context) — estimate 40GB KV storage to cover hot prefixes for 14k daily sessions.
Estimated token throughput: baseline ~16M tokens/day, projected peak month ~160M tokens (campaign-driven bursts).

Cost estimate (pilot): ~$18k-$28k/month for pilot Dedicated cluster (2x A100 + network + infra) depending on quantization and batching settings. Full dedicated footprint expected $60k-$120k/mo for production capacity with autoscaling.
